winner.text: Select checkpoints using the official validation primary metric instead of the GAUC-only early-stopping proxy.
winner.rationale: The experiment currently reports GAUC 0.66937 and nDCG@5 0.53667, while the official primary is their mean at 0.60302. The large top-five weakness in hour slices means GAUC-only stopping can favor checkpoints that do not maximize the stated objective.
winner.exact_ablation: Change only checkpoint selection and early stopping to use the official validation primary, computed as the mean of GAUC and nDCG@5; keep model, loss, features, optimizer, and training data unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Expected -0.0010 to +0.0015 because the selected checkpoint may trade a small amount of GAUC for top-list quality.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Expected +0.0010 to +0.0040 by preventing selection of GAUC-favored but nDCG-weaker checkpoints.

selection_rationale: Select c07 because it is the Consultant's top-ranked, low-leakage, controlled intervention and directly optimizes checkpoint selection for the official primary metric. It addresses the observed GAUC-versus-nDCG mismatch with moderate expected gain, confidence 6, and lower downside than objective or architecture changes.
